_comment: Environments are what an instance is rented with (image, disk, onstart). Recipes are named commands run on a live instance over ssh. Literal text in a template is trusted; every {param} is checked against its type and inserted shell-quoted, never spliced. A `path` param is relative to /workspace/job and may not contain `..`. Images and versions are pinned. `cuda` is the CUDA version the image carries; quote warns when a host lists less. UNVERIFIED.md says what has run on a live Vast host.

base.description: CUDA 12.4 runtime on Ubuntu 22.04, nothing else. For gpu_info and your own run_shell work.

blender.description: Blender 5.2.1 LTS (headless, Cycles on CUDA/OptiX) in /opt/blender, fetched from a Blender mirror and checked against a sha256 pinned here. `ready` shows .blender-ready, or .blender-failed with logs/blender-install.log.
onstart: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq wget xz-utils libxi6 libxxf86vm1 libxfixes3 libxrender1 libgl1 libxkbcommon0 libsm6 libegl1 >/workspace/job/logs/apt.log 2>&1

cd /tmp && for base in https://mirror.clarkson.edu/blender/release https://mirrors.ocf.berkeley.edu/blender/release https://download.blender.org/release; do echo "trying $base"; wget -nv -O blender.tar.xz "$base/Blender5.2/blender-5.2.1-linux-x64.tar.xz" && echo 'a31f524fa99a527d3d52b7f5aaa68c34e1a19d5a1c9473f79c5cc610fd5b10e9  blender.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && break; rm -f blender.tar.xz; done >/workspace/job/logs/blender-install.log 2>&1

if [ -f /tmp/blender.tar.xz ] && mkdir -p /opt/blender && tar -xJf /tmp/blender.tar.xz -C /opt/blender --strip-components=1 >>/workspace/job/logs/blender-install.log 2>&1; then touch /workspace/job/.blender-ready; else touch /workspace/job/.blender-failed; fi

comfy.description: ComfyUI v0.3.10 on PyTorch 2.5.1 / CUDA 12.4 in /workspace/ComfyUI, listening on 127.0.0.1:8188 only (reach it through the `tunnel` tool). Add custom nodes and models with comfy_install_node and comfy_fetch_model.
onstart: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq git wget libgl1 libglib2.0-0 >/workspace/job/logs/apt.log 2>&1

gpu_info.description: The GPU's name, memory and driver, and the CUDA version nvidia-smi reports.

ready.description: Whether the environment's onstart has finished: prints the .<name>-ready markers, or .<name>-failed when an install gave up, and the tail of each log.
ready.template: ls -1A /workspace/job 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[.].*-(ready|failed)$' || echo 'not ready yet'; tail -n 5 /workspace/job/logs/*.log 2>/dev/null || true

blender_render.description: Render frames of an uploaded .blend with Cycles on the GPU. Output goes to /workspace/job/<output> (a Blender output path, e.g. render/frame_####).

blender_script.description: Run an uploaded Python script inside headless Blender: blender -b --factory-startup --python <script> -- <args>. Runs from /workspace/job, so the script finds the files uploaded beside it.

comfy_start.description: Start ComfyUI on 127.0.0.1:8188 in the background. Open a tunnel to reach it.

comfy_install_node.description: Clone a custom node repository into ComfyUI/custom_nodes at a pinned ref and install its requirements. Restart ComfyUI (comfy_start) afterwards.
comfy_install_node.template: cd /workspace/ComfyUI/custom_nodes && git clone {repo} {name} && cd {name} && git checkout {ref} && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi

ref.description: a commit, tag or branch; prefer a commit

comfy_fetch_model.description: Download a model file from Hugging Face into a ComfyUI models folder. comfy_client.py check names what is missing.
